TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: First-class RTK shortcuts prefix native commands and delegate execution to ProxyCmd without duplicating filter logic.
syn read --evidence applies the built-in cat filter while preserving complete raw output in the evidence artifact.
Shortcut --route and --evidence flags use the same behavior as syn proxy.
syn json, syn deps, syn env, and syn wc run as direct local adapters with compact output and adapter-level token tracking.
syn rewrite uses CommandRouter as the hook rewrite source of truth and exits non-zero without stdout for unsupported commands.
syn rewrite rewrites safe shell chains joined by &&, ||, and ; segment by segment, preserves unsupported segments, and skips unsafe redirection and substitution constructs.
syn rewrite rewrites routeable pipeline left edges while preserving pipe filter segments raw and resuming rewrite after subsequent &&, ||, or ; operators.
